English HOME Menu, System Settings, Mii Maker, Game Notes and StreetPass Mii Plaza for Japanese 3DS consoles, without a region change.

### What's new

- **Mii Maker is translated.** Every screen is in English: creating and editing Miis, QR Codes and images, sending and receiving. (Japanese consoles call it Mii Studio; the translation uses the English name, Mii Maker.)
- **Game Notes is in English.** The Japanese app already contains Nintendo's own English text (made for Taiwan), so the tool uses that.
- **StreetPass Mii Plaza is translated.** The plaza itself, Puzzle Swap, Find Mii and Find Mii II, the rabbit's shop and the music list. The paid games you can add to the Plaza (Mii Force, Flower Town and the others) are still in Japanese.
- **The GodMode9 script copies the new apps** along with the HOME Menu and System Settings. For StreetPass Mii Plaza it copies the Plaza's update from the SD card, which is what the translation is made for.

### Updating from v1.1

1. Copy the new `gm9/scripts/dump_system_apps.gm9` to your SD card and run it again. When it asks whether to dump again, choose **No** to keep your existing files and only add the new apps.
2. Copy `gm9/out/3ds-jpn-english` from the SD card into your `dumps` folder again, then build and install as before.

The HOME Menu and System Settings translations haven't changed, so you can keep the files you already have for them.

### How to use it

Download **3ds-jpn-english-v1.2.zip** below and follow the [README](https://github.com/ilex-labs/3ds-jpn-english#readme). You'll need Luma3DS v13.4 or newer, GodMode9 v2.2.3 or newer, and Python 3.8 or newer.

Mii Maker, Game Notes and StreetPass Mii Plaza were tested on a Japanese New 2DS LL.

This download contains no Nintendo files. You copy the original files from your own console, and the tool makes the English versions from them.

The full list of changes is under [Changes from upstream](https://github.com/ilex-labs/3ds-jpn-english#changes-from-upstream).
